column4: toolchain-gated: the cleat#4174 worker test runs real Python components (componentize-py) through a real worker and needs a database, which THIS job does not install. Python is tier 1, and its toolchain is provisioned by the tier-1 Gate rest shard and by e2e-cross-language.yml, not by test-go/commands. The gate is legitimate rather than convenient: buildPythonExample calls t.Fatalf, not t.Skip, when CLEAT_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAINS names python, so a job that PROMISES the toolchain cannot silently skip these. The parent PASSES and each Python SUBTEST skips, because every one calls buildPythonExample first; the Go core-module row builds with the Go toolchain this job has and RUNS. So the count is of Python subtests: 6 today (a 6 s control, a 16 s durable call, a plugin call, a streaming plugin call, and two negative controls). Add a Python row to this test and this number goes up by one.
